design_philosophy: Industrial, robust, precise. Utilizing dark structural grayscale backgrounds (#0A0B0E, #14161A) to emulate a sleek, high-end technical feel, punctuated by electric blue (#0047FF) for high-visibility CTAs. The layout should expose its skeleton using 1px borders (The Technical Look) to reflect engineering precision.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none text-white

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm. Max rounded-md. Keep the aesthetic sharp and engineered.
layout_and_spacing.grid_style: Use technical grid borders (border-collapse, border-white/10) to organize information mechanically.

components.button_primary: bg-[#0047FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0036CC] transition-colors rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.button_secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-medium
components.input_fields: bg-[#14161A] border border-white/10 text-white focus:border-[#0047FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0047FF] rounded-sm p-3 placeholder:text-slate-500
components.glass_header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#0A0B0E]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Sticky glassmorphism header. Logo on left (green R logo, scale down so green acts as an incidental accent). Links: Home, About Us, Products, Why Choose Us, Contact Us. CTA: 'Get a Free Quote' button.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Split-screen layout. Left: H1 'Precision-Engineered Steel Furniture for Home & Office'. High-contrast typography. Electric blue primary CTA 'Get a Quote', Secondary CTA 'View Products'. Right: An overlapping collage or split image of 'hero_office' and 'hero_workshop'. Subtle 'texture_bg' behind the whole section at 10% opacity.

sections.name: Social Proof Banner
sections.description: A technical border-grid band directly under the hero. '4.9/5 Average Rating' with star icons. Badges: 'Premium Steel Grade', 'Custom Manufacturing', '10+ Years Expertise'.

sections.name: Product Categories
sections.description: Showcase of 'Office Furniture' (desks, racks, cupboards) and 'Home Furniture'. Two massive, imposing cards with dark overlays and high-contrast text on hover. Use 'hero_office' for Office and 'category_home' for Home.

sections.name: Why Choose Us
sections.description: Bento Grid layout (Tetris style). Dark gray panels (#14161A) with 1px white/10 borders. Items: Custom Manufacturing, Industrial-Grade Steel, Flawless Finish, Reputed Expertise. Include simple Phosphor/Lucide icons in metallic silver.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.description: Simple clean carousel or 3-column grid of reviews. Use technical border styling. Highlight the robust quality of the furniture in the review text.

sections.name: Contact & Quote Section
sections.description: Split layout. Left: Address, Phone, Email, WhatsApp CTA. Right: 'Get a Free Quote' Form (Name, Email, Phone, Product Interest, Message). Form submits to backend. Electric blue submit button.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Massive 'RINI' typography as a watermark/backdrop. standard links, copyright, minimalist industrial vibe.

real_content.address: RINI ENGINEERING WORKS, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AREA, MUPPATHADOM, 683110

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Pure black is forbidden, use #0A0B0E and #14161A.
The green logo should be placed natively; do not try to filter its color. The contrast against the charcoal background will make it pop subtly without ruining the industrial theme.
Use Bricolage Grotesque for headings and Manrope for body text (import via Google Fonts).
Implement the 'Get a Free Quote' form to connect to a FastAPI backend endpoint that saves the lead.
Include a floating WhatsApp CTA fixed to the bottom right of the viewport.
Ensure ALL interactive elements and major sections have data-testid attributes per the guidelines.
Apply 'Technical Look' borders (1px solid border-white/10) heavily on grids, panels, and sections to give a blueprint/engineering vibe.
